content.text: No insurance clause exists anywhere in the agreement. I'll insert one in General Provisions.

input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (l)
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently contains none even though Licensor supplies and supports the trading technology and handles our order and confidential information. Our position is commercial general liability of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; (iii) where Licensor processes, hosts or otherwise has access to Licensee data or Confidential Information, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than US$5,000,000; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
